mutant.description: Outcome.forStatus's first range takes 200 too (status <= 200), so WebMvcTags.outcome labels a 200 response INFORMATIONAL instead of SUCCESS. It breaks preservation at status 200 and only there; the label stays in the finite set, so the finite-outcome property holds on the mutant by design.

assumptions.text: A non-null response is a carrier whose getStatus() returns one fixed int, with no other effect, and whose other methods are never called by either revision; the claim ranges over that int.
assumptions.basis: Read from the source at both commits: before calls response.getStatus() once and passes it to HttpStatus.Series.resolve; after calls it once and passes it to Outcome.forStatus. Neither calls another method of the response. A response whose getStatus() throws or differs between calls is a different domain, outside this claim; the replay's carrier (replay/driver) throws UnsupportedOperationException from any other method, so a call to one would show as an exception, not be hidden.

assumptions.text: The result is observed by value: its getKey() and getValue() Strings, compared with String.equals. A null result is its own observation.
assumptions.basis: The brief's observation decision (llm-dlc/loops/example-targets-positive.md, P1, and the seed's observation_decision): reference identity is excluded on purpose, because the patch changes which class owns the cached tags. Tag is micrometer's interface; both revisions build their tags with Tag.of(String, String) from micrometer-core, the same dependency at both commits (1.2.0).

assumptions.text: Class initialization runs as on the JVM, never removed: WebMvcTags's static initializer (its cached Tags and the two Pattern.compile calls) on both sides, before's switch-map class WebMvcTags$1 and HttpStatus.Series, and after's Outcome enum, whose constructor calls Tag.of("outcome", name()) six times.
assumptions.basis: The brief's safety rules: class initialization is part of the target's semantics. An initializer the checker can't run is a refusal of the attempt, not an assumption.

assumptions.text: unwind 16 leaves the domain unbounded: the only loop either revision runs is before's for-each over HttpStatus.Series.values(), five iterations; after has none. No String or array is an input.
